configuration.dsbAgent.baseUrl.descripti: Base URL of the Anthropic-compatible API. (After migration the current provider in dsbAgent.providers manages this; kept only as fallback.)
configuration.dsbAgent.providers.descrip: Provider list (manage via 'DSBAgent: Manage Providers' or the settings panel instead of editing by hand).
configuration.dsbAgent.fallbackModels.de: Fallback model list (comma-separated; auto-switch on 429/network/5xx errors).
configuration.dsbAgent.enableNotificatio: Show native notifications when the panel is hidden (task done/error/pending permission).
configuration.dsbAgent.vimMode.descripti: Enable vim mode in the input (normal/insert; i/a to edit, Esc back, j/k/h/l move, dd delete line, x delete char, 0/$ line start/end, gg/G first/last line).
configuration.dsbAgent.permissionMode.de: Permission mode: default=strict (ask for unmatched tools), acceptEdits=auto-accept edits, bypassPermissions=loose (allow anything without confirmations).
Promote pasted editor copies to context chips; when enabled Ctrl+C/Cmd+C records path and line numbers via captureEditorCopy.
configuration.dsbAgent.language.descript: UI language: empty=follow VS Code interface language, zh=Chinese, en=English.
commands.dsbAgent.agentSettings.title: DSBAgent: Agent Settings
configuration.dsbAgent.compaction.histor: Total token budget for history sent to the model (compacted + thinking + tail); 0 disables budget and falls back to legacy behavior.
configuration.dsbAgent.compaction.budget: Budget split ratios for compacted block / thinking block / tail (sum = 1).
configuration.dsbAgent.contextWindowToke: Max input length (context window) sent to the model; 0 follows the model capability (default). Overrides the window used for compaction trigger and output budget when > 0.
configuration.dsbAgent.compaction.trigge: Pipeline trigger ratio: compaction fires when a block reaches rated tokens × this ratio (default 0.75).
configuration.dsbAgent.compaction.target: Post-compaction target ratio: blocks shrink to rated tokens × this ratio (hysteresis, default 0.5, must be < triggerPct).
